lines: The reason I want to spit out this aching longing is
I have no other proof that I exist
The future I thought I had in my grasp
contradicts itself — "dignity" and "freedom"
The reason I want to erase this warped afterimage is
I see my own limits there
In the window of my self-absorbed self
last year's calendar has no dates on it
Erase it, rewrite it
this worthless grand illusion
this presence I can't forget
Rewrite it, for a comeback from the brink
Even meaningless imagining is the driving force that makes you who you are
Give me everything you've got, body and soul
Cut the feelings that had begun to sprout, and cry
Cry, knowing you're ordinary after all
This rotten heart, these filthy lies —
Erase it, rewrite it
this worthless grand illusion
this presence I can't forget
Rewrite it, for a comeback from the brink
Even meaningless imagining is the driving force that makes you who you are
Give me everything you've got, body and soul
